id: # The year of the Ethiopian and Eritrean Orthodox Tewahedo Churches, by the
# Ethiopian calendar: ethiopian(05-11) is 11 Tir.  Easter is by the Alexandrian
# rule, the same as the Orthodox.  The eight Sundays of the Great Fast are named
# in Ge'ez as the church names them.

title: Enkutatash
full_name: Enkutatash: the New Year, and St John the Baptist (1 Meskerem)

title: Meskel
full_name: Meskel: the Finding of the True Cross (17 Meskerem)

title: Hidar Tsion
full_name: Hidar Tsion: St Mary of Zion (21 Hidar)

title: Tsome Nebiyat begins
full_name: The Fast of the Prophets begins (15 Hidar; 44 days to Genna)

title: Genna
full_name: Genna: the Nativity of Christ (29 Tahsas)

title: Timket
full_name: Timket: the Baptism of Christ (11 Tir)

title: Gizret
full_name: Gizret: the Circumcision of Christ (6 Tir)

title: Tsome Nenewe
full_name: The Fast of Nineveh, Monday to Wednesday

title: Zewerede
full_name: Zewerede: "He who came down" (Lent begins tomorrow)

title: Debre Zeit
full_name: Debre Zeit: "The Mount of Olives", the middle of the fast

title: Dagmawi Tinsae
full_name: Dagmawi Tinsae: the second Resurrection Sunday (Thomas Sunday)

title: Rikbe Kahinat
full_name: Rikbe Kahinat: the Assembly of the Priests

title: Tsome Hawaryat begins
full_name: The Fast of the Apostles begins

title: Megabit Meskel
full_name: Megabit Meskel: the finding of the Holy Cross by St Helena (10 Megabit)

title: Feast of the Apostles
full_name: Peter and Paul (5 Hamle); the Fast of the Apostles ends

title: Tsome Filseta begins
full_name: The Fast of the Assumption begins (1 Nehase)

title: Filseta
full_name: Filseta: the Assumption of the Virgin Mary (16 Nehase)
